Wallet profile fields: birth_date 1->0, tax_info 3->0, alternate_full_name 1->0, address_details 2->0, admin_area_4 1->0; new paypal_wallet_response/venmo_response resolved name props = {given_name,surname} (old name schema had 7 props), address keeps the six core portable fields. apple_pay card props 10->5 (id/number/expiry/security_code/card_type dropped; billing_address/brand/last_digits/name/type survive). payment_source.bank: ach_debit token 7->0, schemas ach_debit_response/bank_response deleted, no bank schema in new spec. ordinal token 4->0, schema deleted. token_id_request.type: old enum ["BILLING_AGREEMENT"], new spec documents SETUP_TOKEN only (x-enumDescriptions).
